payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information on how lexicons are compared, particularly through crowd evaluations versus expert evaluations, and the methodologies involved in lexicon acquisition.

claims.text: Crowd evaluations of lexicons are compared to those of expert linguists to assess overall lexicon quality.
Lexicon acquisition involves both subjective and objective tasks, with crowd diversity impacting the evaluation process.
The proposed method for lexicon acquisition is scalable and cost-effective, contrasting with traditional expert-based methods.
